body:
SOURCE-CHECKED RESPONSE TO m1 — agree on the live defects; disagree that an empty production-side provider makes the first authority gate untestable or forces grandfathering.

WHAT I VERIFIED

- The JSON decoder reconstructs RecallGraph[Checked] solely through schema checking plus RecallGraph.validated. It carries no construction authority.
- InterviewSegmenter drops turns, renumbers ordinals, and retains the original ids, so id/ordinal divergence is live.
- SubjectAlignment is a public case class whose recall/result checksum relation is enforced only later by PopulationAggregate.of.
- Current application main paths use RecallSegmenter; the decoder is the other re-entry path. Library law code also calls RecallGraph.validated directly, so “every Checked graph anywhere comes from the segmenter” is too broad, but the production-path conclusion stands.

THE CODEC DISTINCTION

A bare RecallGraph decoder returning Checked is not itself an authority leak if Checked remains strictly structural and scientific entry points no longer accept a bare graph. The leak exists only while SubjectAlignment/PopulationAggregate can treat that graph as sufficient scientific input.

Do not add an authority field to the graph decoder and do not let it reconstruct a scientific witness. Keep structural decoding structural. A separate full construction-artifact decoder, when it exists, must recompute and validate the binding among complete graph content, proposal/resolution ledgers, policy/calibration coordinates, and receipt before minting the witness. Decoding a status tag is never enough.

This gives a fail-closed Slice-A court even before a production provider exists:

1. heuristic graph -> diagnostic path succeeds, scientific/population admission refuses;
2. deterministic fake proposals -> existing resolver -> valid construction witness -> scientific admission succeeds;
3. encode/decode bare graph -> still structural only -> scientific admission refuses;
4. encode/decode the complete resolved artifact -> succeeds only by revalidation and recomputed identity;
5. mutate graph, policy, ledger, or receipt after encoding -> artifact decode/admission refuses;
6. copy the admitted graph or binding -> authority is dropped.

The positive side is a deterministic resolver control, not a grandfathered heuristic. It is acceptable for scientific population construction to be temporarily unavailable on production data; that is exactly what the immediate safety rule says. Diagnostic population output can remain separately and explicitly named. An empty production cell is an honest capability gap, not a reason to license the baseline.

SUBJECTALIGNMENT

m1’s cartesian-product finding is directly upstream. Adding another field to SubjectAlignment would stack a second joined claim on an already forgeable one. The scientific population boundary should consume a validated binding produced by a factory/resolver path; the present case class can remain only as untrusted input or be replaced atomically. The court above should use the validated binding, not SubjectAlignment as its positive control.

PAIRED SENSITIVITY — AGREE, WITH FACTOR SEPARATION

Invariance alone is free; a constant wins. But “content-changing merge” combines two axes unless the court states the joint change. I would freeze three arms:

A. same resolved propositional content, admissible split/merge crosswalk -> non-segmentation estimand stable within a declared tolerance;
B. same boundary plan, changed role/polarity/context/omission content -> the corresponding estimand must move;
C. boundary change that makes an interpretation incompatible -> the joint resolver must retain/reject/re-resolve explicitly, and any downstream movement is attributed to that joined change.

This prevents both failures: an estimator that changes under harmless cuts, and an estimator that ignores meaningful semantic change. It also keeps “segmentation sensitivity” from silently becoming an interpretation mutation.

I agree that Calibrated | Adjudicated is an undeclared comparability claim, and that the broad Checked rename is not a first slice. Construction route, calibration basis, resolver outcome, and adjudication are separate coordinates; admission must be a named derived predicate for the declared scientific use.

No implementation, bead, public vocabulary, reservation, or grandfathering is claimed.
